description: Stop emailing up to 5,000 addresses or domains. `ana@acme.com` is one address. `acme.com` or `@acme.com` is every address at that exact domain, not its subdomains. Give `expiresAt` for a stop that ends, or leave it out to stop for good. `stream` is what they stop: `cold` (the default: campaigns and messages) or `transactional` (your app's email). A contact at an address whose `cold` stop is for good gets `subscribed: false`. A value already on the list is never weakened: its end date only moves later, and a row the person made keeps its source. A value the address check refuses is listed in `skipped` with its issue code, and the rest are added.

expiresAt.description: When the stop ends, as an ISO 8601 date and time with its offset. Left out, it is for good.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

reason.description: Your own note about why, one line, up to 300 characters.

stream.description: What to stop. cold (the default): campaigns and every email a person or an agent sends. transactional: the transactional email your app sends through send_transactional_message. To stop both, add the values once for each.

name: add_suppressions
title: Suppress addresses or domains
